best: Clear titled blocks with explanatory notes, and power paths (pack FET pair, four-switch stage, 3V3 buck) drawn left-to-right like textbook circuits.
worst: Many same-sheet connections done as bare stub net names (VC1-4, SRP/SRN, TS1-4, I2CC_*, CHG_INT) instead of wires, forcing name tracing on the Cells and USB sheets
Text collisions on USB sheets: DRV_SUP label runs into PACK_P label, C_CC2 overlaps DPDN_DCP, stacked GND pin numbers under U401/U405, misplaced 'I2Cc bus pull-ups' note next to C405
Unbalanced space: 3V3 sheet is one thin line on a mostly empty page, Cells and USB have large blank regions while some clusters (BQ294700 cap ladder text over pin wires) are cramped
